hook_route: one fresh original factory then one DecodeHookExec per fixture; no full Decoder, weak or cached route
destinations: valid zero reflect values; defined Time and defined string slice are true named types rather than aliases
fixture_builtin_int_literal_7: interpret the original int specification as int7 without changing its original metadata string

pflag.snapshots: GetSlice once after registration and after each frozen operation; copy ordered full values preserving nil versus nonnil empty
pflag.Changed: read the public returned Flag field, not private stringSliceValue.changed

time_return: for any actual returned time.Time, including zero on error, one Date/Clock/Nanosecond/Zone each; no String/Format/MarshalJSON
error_route: one explicit outer Error; if supported one Unwrap; one cause Error when nonnil; public ParseError fields and direct CSV sentinel identity without extra methods
unsupported_types: retain actual type and unsupported details; do not force known classification
panic_route: separate primary/getter/error panics; type and primitive string only, nonstring text null with explicit unobserved flag
checkpoint: intent saved before each explicitly budgeted dispatch; undispatched channels null; unexpected differences and storage/timeout limits retained
